description: This class includes the manufacture of watches, clocks and timing devices.
includes: manufacture of watches and watch parts: cases, mechanisms, movements, straps, bracelets
manufacture of clocks and clock parts: alarm clocks, wall clocks, bedside clocks, stopwatches
manufacture of time registers and time recorders
manufacture of instrument panel clocks and other timing devices for vehicles and aircraft
manufacture of clock or watch springs
manufacture of time switches and other timing devices
excludes: manufacture of electronic components used in watches and clocks, see 2610
manufacture of measuring and control instruments, see 2651
manufacture of jewellery for watches, see 3211
